gpt.rationale: The mostly subdued fear/surprise choices fit an introvert under stress, but repeated overt surprise on quieter, tentative lines like "This is why I'm late...?" and relieved "So that's it...?" weakens personality fit even though the scene’s emotional arc is largely tracked correctly.

claude.rationale: Aoi's sprite choices rely heavily on fear and surprise, but an introverted character would express panic and wonder through subtler cues (downcast eyes, quiet pauses, slight tension) rather than overt emotional displays; the repeated surprise sprites especially fail to capture the reserved, internal processing expected of this personality.
